experience.title: Final Year Project - Pharmatrack
experience.institution: Universiti Pendidikan Sultan Idris, Tanjung Malim, Perak
experience.description: A Laravel-based web application for managing and monitoring patient health and medication records in community pharmacies. Built using the Iterative and Incremental SDLC model, PharmaTrack centralizes patient registration, medication tracking, and health monitoring — replacing manual, scattered record-keeping with organized digital records and AI-driven recommendations. Developed with Laravel 12, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Face-API.js, and OCR. Achieved 100% pass rate across 26 UAT test cases with 8 respondents.
